ABOUT FABRICATION INTELLIGENCE

Built around real things people cannot source.

We are three RMIT architecture students testing a simple idea: one Australian contact can make overseas fabrication clearer, more comparable and easier to manage.

WHY IT EXISTS

Good designs get changed because sourcing is hard.

Custom building products can be slow or expensive locally. Overseas makers may be able to produce them, but finding a suitable manufacturer, comparing inconsistent quotes and calculating the real delivered cost is work most project teams cannot take on.

OUR PILOT

Demand first.

We do not choose a product and hope somebody wants it. We start with a person who has a specific unmet need, then source that item and learn the category through a real job.

THE TEAM

Three roles. One personally managed service.

PR

PREM · CEO

Customer & strategy

Prem leads planning, project scope and customer conversations. He keeps each pilot focused on a real sourcing problem and a clear decision.

LI

LINCY · CPO

Product & research

MO

Build & testing

Moss builds and tests the website and working demo. He ships the product in small, testable releases and keeps the bug log honest.

Founder portraits will replace the initials after the team supplies approved photos.
